articles.title: Jackson, USACE breaks ground on new child center
articles.summary: Fort Jackson and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers broke ground Oct. 20 on a new child development center that is a sign of the commitment to its families and to Army readiness.

articles.title: Pentagon ignored cybersecurity flaws before data breach, Marines’ lawsuit says

articles.title: Pentagon, Lockheed agree to decade-long F-35 framework deal for hundreds of jets
articles.summary: The tentative agreement, which still needs lawmakers’ blessing, covers production and sustainment over the 10 years.

articles.title: 156th Wing optometrist bridges healthcare gaps, earns national award

Alex Garcia, an optometrist assigned to the 156th Medical Group, Puerto Rico Air National Guard, was named the Reserve/Guard Optometrist of the Year by the Armed Forces Optometric Society during the 2026 AFOS Convention in Las Vegas, Nevada, Sept. 15–20, 2026.

articles.title: Right time, right place, right Airman
articles.summary: AVIANO AIR BASE, Italy— In a moment, an ordinary drive to work became an emergency. On the morning of August 26, 2026, U.S. Air Force Tech. Sgt. Danielle Smith, 31st Operational Medical Readiness Squadron medical technician, witnessed a vehicle accident in her Italian community. The car hit a utility pole and overturned.

articles.title: Ukraine to be able to buy military supplies via NATO agency: report
articles.summary: The deal comes amid worsening U.S.-Ukraine relations since U.S. President Trump announced a diesel export deal with Russia this month to lower U.S. prices.

articles.title: USACE Far East District Hosts First Reverse Industry Day
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers – Far East District (USACE FED) Contracting Division hosted its first Reverse Industry Day (FEDRID), Oct. 6, 2025, in Suwon, South Korea. Over 250 attendees attended the event.

articles.title: 5th Air Naval Gunfire Liaison Company, Japan Ground Self-Defense Force strengthen partnership through joint fires training

articles.title: U.S. Army Yuma Test Center Commander mentors local Army JROTC cadets
articles.summary: U.S. Army Yuma Test Center Commander Lt. Col. Kevin Hicks spoke to a large assembly of Army Junior Reserve Officers’ Training Corps cadets at Yuma High School on October 21, 2026.

articles.title: 129th Rescue Wing conducts first wildfire medevac mission with HH-60W helicopter
articles.summary: The California Air National Guard’s 129th Rescue Wing deployed its new HH-60W Jolly Green II helicopter to support wildfire operations in Yosemite National Park, Oct. 9-12, marking the aircraft’s first wildfire mission since the wing began transitioning from the HH-60G Pave Hawk last year.

articles.title: Brig. Gen. Landers debriefs command climate survey results at town hall
articles.summary: U.S. Army Brig. Gen. Andrew L. Landers, director of Defense Health Network Pacific and commanding general of Medical Readiness Command, Pacific, addressed service members and staff during a Defense Organizational Climate Survey town hall meeting at Tripler Army Medical Center, Hawaii, Oct. 19, 2026.

articles.title: U.S. Army Garrison-Fort McCoy chaplain supports 98th ARRTC activation with invocation
articles.summary: As the 98th Army Reserve Readiness Training Center (ARRTC) officially activated Oct. 21 at Fort McCoy, Chaplain (Lt. Col.) Walter McCall, garrison chaplain for U.S. Army Garrison-Fort McCoy, provided an invocation recognizing the significance of the occasion and the Soldiers and leaders beginning a new chapter in the organization’s history.

articles.title: Coast Guard Cutter Munro completes Arctic patrol, strengthens U.S. presence in high north
articles.summary: ALAMEDA, Calif. — The crew of Coast Guard Cutter Munro (WMSL 755) returned to their Base Alameda homeport on Coast Guard Island Oct. 9, 2026, following a 112-day Alaska patrol that covered more than 23,000 nautical miles across the Bering Sea and Arctic Ocean.

articles.title: NPS Announces Nine Digital Trident II Projects Addressing Pacific Operational Challenges
articles.summary: The Naval Postgraduate School Office of Research and Innovation announced nine projects selected for development through the Digital Trident II initiative. Chosen through a competitive process, the projects bring NPS researchers, operational stakeholders and partners together to address consequential challenges facing U.S. forces in the Pacific.

articles.title: Military Firefighters host a week of events to vitalize fire prevention
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Col. Matthew Norton, 17th Training Wing commander, signed a proclamation on Oct. 5, commencing Fire Prevention Week 2026: “Charge into Fire Safety: Lithium-Ion Batteries in Your Home.”

The panel included input from Josh Gwinn, IMCOM's Director of Family, Morale, Welfare and Recreation.
